mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remediation_plan (incident_id, diagnosis_id, title, summary, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{diagnosisId}, #{title}, #{summary}, 'ACTIVE', #{at}, #{at})

INSERT INTO remediation_action (remediation_plan_id, capability_key, target_resource_id, parameter_schema_name, parameter_schema_version, parameter_payload, summary, expected_impact_summary, risk_level, requires_approval, created_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{capabilityKey}, #{targetResourceId}, #{schemaName}, #{schemaVersion}, #{payload}, #{summary}, #{expectedImpactSummary}, #{riskLevel}, #{requiresApproval}, #{at})
INSERT INTO approval_request (remediation_action_id, status, requested_at, created_at, updated_at, lock_version) VALUES (#{actionId}, 'PENDING', #{at}, #{at}, #{at}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.incident_id FROM approval_request a JOIN remediation_action ra ON ra.id = a.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = ra.remediation_plan_id WHERE a.id = #{approvalId}

SELECT a.id, a.remediation_action_id, a.status, a.requested_at, a.decided_by, a.decided_at, a.comment, a.lock_version, p.id AS plan_id, p.status AS plan_status, p.diagnosis_id, ra.capability_key, ra.target_resource_id FROM approval_request a JOIN remediation_action ra ON ra.id = a.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = ra.remediation_plan_id WHERE a.id = #{approvalId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_request SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, comment = #{comment}, updated_at = #{decidedAt}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{approvalId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.status, a.lock_version, i.incident_key, ra.id AS action_id, ra.summary AS action_summary, ra.capability_key, r.resource_key, r.name AS resource_name, ra.risk_level, ra.expected_impact_summary, a.requested_at, a.decided_by, a.decided_at, a.comment FROM approval_request a JOIN remediation_action ra ON ra.id = a.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = ra.remediation_plan_id JOIN incident i ON i.id = p.incident_id JOIN managed_resource r ON r.id = ra.target_resource_id WHERE a.id = #{approvalId}
